sermon.title: Restoration
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: In this session on present truth, Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that after the falling away God began the restoration of all things foretold in Acts 3. He traces what he says God restored step by step, from the Bible in the common language, Bible morals and justification by faith to believer’s baptism, divine healing, Holy Spirit baptism, unity, the five offices and praise, warns how restored truths were distorted, and says God will restore anyone now.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: This is a session on “present truth” following “The Falling Away.” At 2:35 the captions read “Hebrews 5:13 and Hebrews 62” (Hebrews 6:2); at 5:29 “Psalms 1382” is Psalm 138:2; at 7:18 the year before Martin Luther is spoken as “15178” in the captions. Names of some people were not clear in the captions and are marked [unclear]. Historical dates and figures (e.g. 1170, 1229, 1524, 1870, 1906, 1948, the share of Americans who are Christians) are given as spoken and have not been checked.

faqs.question: What do “repent” and “be converted” mean?
faqs.answer: He says repent means to turn from wrong and converted means to turn to right, to morality, and that is how your sins are blotted out.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Repent therefore and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, so that times of refreshing may come from the presence of the Lord,

faqs.question: What are the foundational doctrines of Christ in Hebrews 6?
faqs.answer: He lists repentance from dead works, faith toward God, doctrines of baptisms (water, the Holy Spirit and into the body of Christ), laying on of hands, resurrection of the dead and eternal judgment.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Therefore, leaving the discussion of the elementary principles of Christ, let us go on to perfection, not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works and of faith toward God, of the doctrine of baptisms, of laying on of hands, of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.

faqs.question: How many judgments are there?
faqs.answer: He says there is only one judgment and it is eternal, either in the lake of fire or with Christ in a new heaven and new earth.

faqs.question: What is the Bible definition of faith?
faqs.answer: From Hebrews 11:1 he says faith is the substance, the reality, of things hoped for and the evidence, the proof, of things not seen.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.

faqs.question: Where should your faith stand?
faqs.answer: He says not in the wisdom of men, your own faith, someone else’s faith or the church, but in the power, the supernatural ability, of God to perform his promises.

scriptures.text_nkjv: that your faith should not be in the wisdom of men but in the power of God.

faqs.question: Were the Anabaptists against water baptism?
faqs.answer: He says they were against infant baptism, not water baptism; they taught you must be water baptized after you repent, not as a baby.

faqs.question: What gets lost when groups divide over doctrine?
faqs.answer: He says loving God, loving your neighbor and loving yourself gets lost amid theology.

faqs.question: What are the three kinds of prophecy?
faqs.answer: He says edification and exhortation to the body of Christ, which almost anyone can do; the office of a prophet, who predicts and it comes to pass, seldom seen; and personal prophecy confirming a position in the body of Christ.

faqs.question: Will God restore someone who has failed him many times?
faqs.answer: He says he does not care how many times you think you failed Christ; he will restore you and refresh you, even out of the time you missed.
